result: No portable state solution passed both bidirectional LODO coverage and nuisance-confound gates on the independent EDF dataset.
generalization_note: Confirmation in this two-dataset task is distinct from a general EEG state claim, which remains gated on recurrence in a third dataset.

decision_rule.subject_dominated: maximum subject share within any state > 0.30
decision_rule.dataset_or_device_dominated: maximum dataset share > 0.80 or Cramer's V > 0.50
decision_rule.qc_dominated: maximum normalized mutual information with a QC variable > 0.20
decision_rule.independent_edf_confirmation: confound and LODO gates pass in both directions
decision_rule.general_cross_dataset_claim: later recurrence in at least three independent datasets

interpretation_policy: Task/run annotations were excluded from all feature, scaling, clustering, model-selection, and LODO fitting steps and joined only afterward.
